name: feature-flags
intro: The feature flags of this version: features still in development, off by default and reserved to development and testing. A guide never names a flag: it describes the platform without them. A flag disappears from the registry when its feature ships to everyone.

sections.title: Turn a flag on
sections.text: Set `FEATURE_FLAGS` to the flags to turn on, separated by commas (`FEATURE_FLAGS=enterprise-edition-status`), or to `*` for every flag. A name the registry does not hold stops the platform at boot.
